relationships.subject: pain expectation
relationships.evidence_quote: the insular cortex, dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC), and anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) showed increased activity for directed expectations regardless of their valence

key_findings: Positive and negative expectations share representation during anticipation and diverge only once nociceptive input arrives.
fMRI-informed EEG shows early DLPFC, then anterior insula, then late ACC effects.
